editorial:
You know exactly what you are getting into with this one, and that is half the fun. A freak storm drops a tornado full of sharks right onto New York City, and only Fin and April stand between the Big Apple and total chaos. The movie leans hard into its silly premise, throwing sharks at famous landmarks and letting the city itself become part of the joke. It is loud, fast, and completely unafraid to be ridiculous, which makes it a perfect pick for a movie night with friends who want something easy to laugh at.

The action keeps moving from one set piece to the next, and the cast plays everything straight enough to sell the madness. You will notice some rough effects and cheesy dialogue, but that is part of the charm rather than a flaw. If you enjoy campy disaster movies and do not mind turning your brain off for ninety minutes, this delivers exactly what it promises. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the full experience on your shelf.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Fin uses a chainsaw to fight through the shark-filled storm and save April, who had been injured earlier. The tornado finally breaks apart, and the sharks rain down across the city. Fin and April survive and reunite, with the city safe once again. The movie ends on a hopeful note, hinting that the sharknado threat may not be over for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves campy disaster movies and silly action with friends.
